units: <cite ref="Gittin 65b:10">Gitt. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>עשו לה כנ׳</he> deal with her according to law.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:7">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>בנ׳ המלכות</he> in accordance with the royal usage of warfare; (Tanḥ. Bo 4, a. e. <he>כטַקְסִין</he>).

<cite ref="Gittin 43b:10">Gitt. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שעשה</he> … <he>נִימוֹסוֹ</he> Ar. (ed. <he>נמוסו</he>) as soon as the gentile did to him (the hypothecated slave) what the law requires (to take possession, v. <cite ref="N01344"><he>נַשְׁקִי</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:16">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:16">IV</cite>), 16 <he>נימוסות</he> (corr. acc.). Gitt. l. c. [read:] <he>אע״פ שעשה לה נִימוֹסָהּ</he> although he (the Jew) did what the law requires in regard to the field; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נִימוֹסִין</he>, <he>נִימוֹסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:8">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>בדרכי הגוים יש נ׳ וכ׳</he> it is the way of the nations to have many religious observances (for various deities) and many priests.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>בשלשה … בנ׳</he> (Ar. <he>בנַוְוסִין</he>) in three things is Greece in advance of Rome: in codes &c., v. <cite ref="Q01203"><he>פַּנִּיקְטִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8">Num. R. s. 8</cite> <he>בנ׳ שלנו</he> in our (Roman) law; a. e.—[<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>הוציא הנמוסין</he> read: <he>הטוֹמוֹסִין</he>, v. <cite ref="I00177"><he>טוֹמוֹס</he></cite>.]
